description:
Use this when the user wants to change their public RipClip page: "update my bio", "pin my favourite clips".
Anyone can see the page, so confirm the words with the user first. Only what is passed changes; a pinned clip
is a public copy, and removing a clip is done in RipClip.
Not for: a clip's own title or captions (edit_clip). Free: no Horizon Units.

auto_posted.description: True adds clips RipClip posts in public to the page by themselves. Empty leaves it unchanged.

bio.description: New bio, up to 200 characters; replaces the old one. Empty leaves it unchanged.

links.description: The whole link list, replacing the old one: up to 8, each a label (40 characters) and an https url.

pinned_clip_ids.description: Clip ids from list_clips to show on the page, up to 20; ones already there stay.

name: update_public_profile
title: Update my public profile
